name: Poyopoyo Oppai Summer
original_name: ポヨポヨおっぱいさま～
source:
The summer of Japan is the summer of breasts!?

This is a comical story where a boyish girl and a huge-breasted woman who is expected to be a worldwide scientist in the future!
They fight over the protagonist, who happens to love big breasts above all!
